chunks: And from him, from Fadalah, from Rifah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who visits the House (Kaaba) during the days of Tashriq, and he said, 'Yes, if God wills.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to visit the Kaaba during the days of Tashriq after Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms the permissibility of performing ziyarah to the Kaaba during the days of Tashriq, clarifying that the ritual acts of Hajj are not mutually exclusive. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it distinguishes the specific timing of visiting the House from the general prohibition of lingering in Mina, allowing pilgrims to combine the spiritual benefits of both acts within the same pilgrimage cycle.
